# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 107 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 107 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_107_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 24

**1** I asked him about the seasons and why the tower was not built on a level plain but on a rock and on water. **2** He said to me, "You are wise asking about the foundation of the tower. **3** I asked the reason why it was built on water, and he said to me, 'I told you so before and you are still asking. Your inquiry is good: listen. **4** The rock and the water are one. The rock is the Son of God. He was before all things, and he appeared in the last days of the present age. **5** The water was before all things, and this is why water is used for cleansing and entering eternal life; for the earth was created by water. **6** Therefore the rock is old and the water is young; but through baptism men enter the kingdom of God and are cleansed from their sins and defilements, through the name of the Son of God. **7** The rock and the water are one; they are inseparable. Whoever comes to God must pass through both: through water for cleansing, and through the rock for standing firm. **8** The foundation of all life is one: the Son of God.'"

---

*EMET: the synthesis of rock and water as the unified foundation of the Church is the crowning theological statement of Similitude 9. Rock (pre-existent Son) + Water (baptism) = single foundation of eternal life.*
